newsitem.title: USA: Universal Seismic says sells $2 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Universal Seismic says sells $2 mln in notes.

text.p: Universal Seismic Associates Inc said Friday it sold $2 million of its senior secured general obligation notes to Resource Investors Management Co.
The company said the notes have a three-year maturity and will function as a revolving credit line with payments of interest only.

The company also said Resources Investors has expanded its general obligation credit facility with Universal's energy subsidiary, UNEXCO, by $1.5 million to a total of $4.5 million. The company said all the terms of the expanded facility remain substantially the same.
